summary: Iter 28 tested: (1) Backend GET /api/live/status returns correct shape with isLive, checkedAt, and populated watchUrl/embedUrl when channel is live (channel IS live during test — verified). refresh=true forces fresh poll. (2) Featured schedule: POST/PATCH /admin/schedule with featured=true correctly un-features all other slots (single-featured invariant). New `description` field round-trips through GET /radio/schedule. (3) Frontend Home: YouTube LIVE red banner ('LIVE NOW · YOUTUBE' pill + WATCH ON YOUTUBE button) renders correctly (channel was actually live). REMIND ME button (testID sched-remind-{id}) visible for non-live slots. 'UP NEXT · FEATURED' star pill renders on featured non-live slot. (4) Frontend Admin /admin/schedule: 'Feature at top of Home' Switch (sched-featured) + description textarea (sched-description) present. FEATURED star badge renders on list rows. (5) expo-notifications imports cleanly on web with only a benign warning ('Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web'); page does NOT crash. All 7 pytest cases + all UI checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Web Alert.alert() from React Native web sometimes doesn't surface as a browser dialog in Playwright — REMIND ME on web technically shows an Alert but couldn't be automation-verified via dialog handler. Manual verification confirms Alert.alert call path in code (Home line 70). Not a bug.
Note: reminders.ts uses `trigger: { date: trigger }` with @ts-expect-error — expo-notifications SDK 53+ prefers `SchedulableTriggerInputTypes.DATE`. Works but could be tightened.
Console warning on web: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents` — pre-existing, not iter28-specific.
